title: Preflop hand-vs-hand equity
description: Win, tie and lose chances for every pair of the 169 starting-hand classes, each averaged over every pair of specific hands that share no card and every five-card board.

data.description: Preflop hand-class matchups. matrix[hero][villain] is [win, tie, lose] for the hero class against the villain class, as fractions to 5 decimals that sum to exactly 1. Each cell averages every pair of specific hands that use no card twice (so a class counts by its combos) over every five-card board.

methodKey.e: exact: every board of every suit assignment enumerated
methodKey.m: mc: seeded Monte Carlo, see monteCarlo

exact.note: every pair of classes, a class against itself included, with hero and villain counted once
